description_en: Validates whether the playbook configuration is correct and whether the orchestration logic is reasonable
description_zh: 校验剧本的配置是否正确，编排的逻辑是否合理
name: VerifyPlaybook

parameters.help_en:
The UUID of the playbook.
Call the [DescribePlaybooks](~~DescribePlaybooks~~) operation to obtain this parameter.
Note: You must specify at least one of PlaybookUuid and TaskFlow. You can call the DescribePlaybooks operation to obtain a valid PlaybookUuid
parameters.help_zh:
剧本的UUID。
调用[DescribePlaybooks](~~DescribePlaybooks~~)接口可以获取该参数。
注意：PlaybookUuid 和 TaskFlow 至少需要提供一个；可通过 DescribePlaybooks 接口获取有效的 PlaybookUuid
parameters.name: playbook_uuid

parameters.help_en: The XML configuration of the playbook
parameters.name: task_flow

Detail.description_en: The specific fault message when the check fails
Detail.description_zh: 检查未通过时的具体错误信息
Detail.example: Node [python3_3] doesn't have the asset information

NodeName.description_en: The node name of the playbook

RiskLevel.description_en:
The severity level of the validation information. Valid values:
warn: Warning. Issues may occur during playbook execution.
error: Error. The playbook cannot be compiled.
remind: Suggestion. This does not affect the publishing or execution of the playbook. Optimizing the playbook format is recommended
RiskLevel.description_zh:
校验信息的提示等级。取值：
warn：警告提示，在剧本运行过程中可能出现问题。
error：错误提示，剧本无法编译通过。
remind：建议提示，不影响剧本的发布与运行，建议优化剧本格式

Prerequisites.description_en: The prerequisite check information for the playbook

PrerequisiteType.description_en:
The check type. Valid values:
role: RAM custom role name.
policies: list of RAM system policies
PrerequisiteType.description_zh:
检验类型。取值：
role：RAM自定义角色名称。
policies：RAM系统策略列表

PrerequisiteValue.description_en:
The check content. Valid values:
PrerequisiteType is role: the fixed value AliyunSiemSoarExecutionDefaultRole.
PrerequisiteType is policies: a collection of policy names
PrerequisiteValue.description_zh:
检查内容。取值：
PrerequisiteType为role：为固定值 AliyunSiemSoarExecutionDefaultRole。
PrerequisiteType为policies：是策略名称的集合

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request. You can use it to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
